entities.name: Query MurE ligase
observations: 495 aa soluble bacterial enzyme; predicted molecular mass 52.14 kDa and theoretical pI 5.42.
Contains Mur_ligase (PF01225), Mur_ligase_M (PF08245), and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) domains.
Closest reviewed homologs are MurE ligases Q9A595, Q89FU2, and Q98KA8 with 51.9–54.0% identity, 91.9–94.1% query coverage, and E-values 2.7e-148 to 3.4e-143.
Homolog annotations support UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase activity, EC 6.3.2.13, in cytoplasmic peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
The inferred reaction uses ATP and Mg2+ to add meso-2,6-diaminopimelate to UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate, producing UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-meso-DAP, ADP, and phosphate.

A conserved C-terminal meso-diaminopimelate recognition motif and homologous N6-carboxylysine feature support MurE-family catalytic architecture; exact residue mapping to the query is not experimentally established.
Functional assignment is supported primarily by strong homology to reviewed Swiss-Prot proteins, not by a direct biochemical assay of this sequence.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: Reaction is recorded for close reviewed MurE homologs as Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE ligase incorporates meso-diaminopimelate into the UDP-MurNAc pentapeptide precursor during bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
Close reviewed homologs are annotated to cell-wall biogenesis, peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and regulation of cell shape.

entities.name: MurE Mg2+ dependence
observations: Close reviewed MurE homologs are annotated as ATP-binding and magnesium-ion-binding enzymes; Mg2+ is the reported cofactor for the ligase reaction.
